title: Customer Service & Complaints
completion_message: ¡Excelente trabajo! Has aprendido a manejar quejas y ofrecer un gran servicio al cliente.

parts.visual: Manejo de quejas: I apologize for the inconvenience (Me disculpo por las molestias). Let me resolve this issue (Déjeme resolver este problema). Complaint = Queja. Complain = Quejarse.
parts.audio: Handling complaints. I apologize for the inconvenience. Let me resolve this issue. A complaint is a noun, meaning 'queja'. To complain is the verb, meaning 'quejarse'.

parts.visual: Soluciones: We can offer you a full refund (reembolso completo). I will send a replacement immediately (un reemplazo). Thank you for your patience (Gracias por su paciencia).
parts.audio: Solutions. We can offer you a full refund. I will send a replacement immediately. Thank you for your patience.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta para atender al cliente.

questions.question: I would like to make a ____. The product is broken. (Queja).
questions.explanation: Make a complaint = hacer una queja.

questions.question: The customer called to ____ about the late delivery. (Quejarse).
I sincerely ____ for the delay. (Me disculpo).
We apologize for the ____. (Molestias/Inconveniencia).
questions.explanation: Inconvenience es la palabra formal para molestias.

questions.question: Let me ____ this issue for you right away. (Resolver).
questions.explanation: Resolve an issue = resolver un problema.

questions.question: Since the item is broken, we will send a ____. (Reemplazo).
If you don't want the item, we can offer a full ____. (Reembolso).
Thank you for your ____ while we fix the server. (Paciencia).
I will ____ into this matter immediately. (Investigar/Revisar).
questions.explanation: Look into (phrasal verb) = investigar / revisar un asunto.

questions.question: Can I have your order ____, please? (Número).
I assure you this won't happen ____. (De nuevo).
questions.explanation: Won't happen again = no volverá a ocurrir.

questions.question: I am ____ to hear that you had a bad experience. (Lamento/Siento).
questions.explanation: I am sorry to hear that... = lamento escuchar eso.

questions.question: Is there anything else I can ____ you with? (Ayudar).
We need to ____ the customer's expectations. (Cumplir/Satisfacer).
The item is ____. It doesn't work. (Defectuoso).
I will escalate this ____ to my manager. (Problema/Asunto).
questions.explanation: Issue = problema/asunto. Escalate = escalar (a un superior).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave de servicio al cliente.

questions.question: I want to make a ____. (Queja - sustantivo)
I will ____ into it. (Investigar - phrasal verb)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.
